column6: Say to the governor and temple administrator what @wPN{Ur-Enlila} says:

The irrigation ditch which has been cleared was bringing water but @varh[t3304.v1]{@wPN{Enlil-diŋirŋu} } @vart[t3304.v2,t3304.v1]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} @wPN{Enlil-aŋu} } @vart[t3304.v3,t3304.v1]{@varn{another ms. has instead:} @wPN{Enlilaŋu} } and @wPN{Ḫanzamu} have drawn off the water and taken it from the ditch.

I proposed, @q{“@varh[t3304.v4]{Water should be brought } @vart[t3304.v5,t3304.v4]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} The irrigation should be done } on the basis of one ditch for me, one ditch for you and one ditch for the governor,”} but they did not agree. Your canal has no workers but its ditch brings water. It brings water for me unchecked. My workforce is inadequate so send me five or @varh[t3304.v6]{10 } @vart[t3304.v7,t3304.v6]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} 60 } able-bodied men. It is urgent.
